discrepancies.replication: Not performed; equal cell numbers only
discrepancies.note: Same limitation as the human track; non-UMI read counts (Smart-seq2, C1HT, ICELL8) not comparable to UMIs.
GEO metadata has no cell types, so ARI measures species agreement. MT-/MT. prefixes miss mouse ENSMUSG IDs; min_genes>=200 is the only effective QC.

discrepancies.paper: Joint human-mouse-dog mapping per protocol; species mix reported per protocol (Fig. 1)
discrepancies.replication: GSE141469 ships split matrices (human/mouse exp_mat); 10X_V3 composition is single-species by construction (Human 1.0 / Mouse 1.0)
discrepancies.note: Same structural caveat as the human track; R25/R29/R30 points for 10X_V3 excluded from species-share interpretation.

similarity.qc_note: means over cells with >=200 genes (mito gate skipped: ENSEMBL IDs)

depths.note: median genes at thinned UMI depth (binomial, seed 0, <=60 QC cells/protocol)

joint.note: joint log1p-CP10K HVG PCA, <=100 QC cells/protocol, seed 0

mixability.note: kBET-style chi2 neighbourhood test (k=25, alpha=0.05) PRE-integration; low = well mixed

scanpy.note: scanpy 2nd track: normalize_total/log1p, Seurat-flavor HVG, PCA, kNN, Leiden, UMAP, t-test markers; seeds from config
